messages.subject: Re: [MplusAutomation] Function for checking proper convergence
parts:
Hi Jon,

Thanks for the email and I'm glad you like the package!

Are you just looking for the various warnings Mplus prints, or something extra?  

Cheers,

Josh



On Tue, Sep 1, 2015 at 9:10 AM, Jonathan Lehrfeld <jmleh...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi,

I love this package and use it all the time. I have a feature request though: would it be possible to get a function that could check for proper convergence? Not just checking whether there is a "no convergence" error message, but also checking all the other things that might lead the results to be classified as either non-converged or generally improper, such as negative variance estimates and non-positive-definite model-implied covariance matrices? Having that all in one place would be incredibly helpful!

Best,
Jon

Hi Jon and Josh,

I apologize: I had previously replied to Jon, but apparently did not CC the Google group. It turns out he was not aware of the $warnings and $errors fields returned by readModels, but this is what he needed. So, the issue is resolved.

Best,
Michael
